questions.stem: 照顧年邁父母時，許多中年人還得兼顧工作與家庭，這常讓他們身心俱疲。
questions.answer: While caring for their elderly parents, many middle-aged people must also balance work and family, which often leaves them physically and mentally exhausted.
accepted_answers: When looking after their elderly parents, many middle-aged people also have to balance their jobs and families, which often makes them physically and mentally exhausted.
While taking care of their aged parents, many middle-aged people also need to juggle work and family, which often wears them out both physically and mentally.

patterns: 非限定關係子句（, which 指前面整件事）

questions.stem: 然而，許多家庭仍不確定自己是否有資格使用由政府提供的長期照護服務。
questions.answer: However, many families are still not sure whether they are eligible for the long-term care services provided by the government.
accepted_answers: However, many families are still unsure whether or not they qualify for the long-term care services offered by the government.
However, many families remain uncertain whether they have the right to use the long-term care services provided by the government.

patterns: whether 名詞子句（間接問句）
分詞片語後位修飾（N + p.p. + by）

1.explanation_zh: 「照顧年邁父母時」的主詞和後面的「許多中年人」相同，可用連接詞＋分詞 While caring for …／When taking care of …（＝While they are caring for …）。「兼顧工作與家庭」是在兩者之間取得平衡 balance work and family。「這常讓他們身心俱疲」的「這」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 , which often leaves/makes them physically and mentally exhausted（which 前面要有逗號）。
1.strategy_zh: 中文句首「…時」若和主要子句同主詞，可用 While/When + V-ing；句尾「這讓…」指前面整件事時用 , which …。
hints: 切成四段：照顧年邁父母時／許多中年人／還得兼顧工作與家庭／這常讓他們身心俱疲
標的詞彙：care（照顧）、elderly（年長的）、middle-aged（中年的）、balance（兼顧、平衡）、exhausted（精疲力盡的）
句型框架：While + V-ing …, S + must also + V …, which + often + leaves/makes + O + adj.

2.explanation_zh: 「是否」引出間接問句 whether they are eligible for …（whether／if＋直述句語序）；「有資格」用 be eligible for 或 qualify for。「由政府提供的長期照護服務」修飾語很長，英文把名詞放前面，用過去分詞片語後位修飾：the long-term care services provided by the government（服務是被提供的，用 provided）。
evidence: 由政府提供的長期照護服務
2.strategy_zh: 「不確定是否…」→ be not sure whether + S + V；「由…提供的 N」→ N + provided by …。
hints: 切成四段：然而，許多家庭仍不確定／自己是否有資格使用／由政府提供的／長期照護服務
標的詞彙：family（家庭）、eligible（有資格的）、provide（提供）、government（政府）、long-term（長期的）、care（照護）、service（服務）
句型框架：However, S + be still not sure + whether + S + be eligible for + N + p.p. + by …

references: While caring for their elderly parents, many middle-aged people must also balance work and family, which often leaves them physically and mentally exhausted.
When looking after their elderly parents, many middle-aged people also have to balance their jobs and families, which often makes them physically and mentally exhausted.
While taking care of their aged parents, many middle-aged people also need to juggle work and family, which often wears them out both physically and mentally.

patterns.label_zh: 非限定關係子句（which 指前面整件事）
patterns.frame: S + V …, which + V + O + adj.

accepted: While caring for their elderly parents
When looking after their elderly parents
While taking care of their aged parents
When taking care of their elderly parents

common_errors.right: While caring for their elderly parents
common_errors.explanation_zh: care 當「照顧」要接 for（care for）；也可用 take care of／look after。

common_errors.wrong: While they caring for their elderly parents
common_errors.right: While caring for their elderly parents
common_errors.explanation_zh: 連接詞後面接分詞時，主詞和 be 動詞一起省略；要保留主詞就寫完整子句 While they are caring for …。

accepted: many middle-aged people
a lot of middle-aged people

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「中年的」是形容詞 middle-aged（有連字號、字尾 -ed）。

accepted: must also balance work and family
also have to balance their jobs and families
also need to juggle work and family
also have to balance work and family

common_errors.wrong: also have to take care work and family
common_errors.right: also have to balance work and family
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「兼顧」是在兩者之間取得平衡，用 balance／juggle；take care 後面少了 of，意思也不同。

common_errors.wrong: also has to balance work and family
common_errors.right: also have to balance work and family
common_errors.explanation_zh: 主詞 many middle-aged people 是複數，用 have to。

accepted: which often leaves them physically and mentally exhausted
which often makes them physically and mentally exhausted
which often wears them out both physically and mentally

common_errors.wrong: this often makes them physically and mentally exhausted
common_errors.right: which often leaves them physically and mentally exhausted
common_errors.explanation_zh: 逗號後直接接 this 會變成兩個子句硬接（逗號接句）；用 which 指前面整件事，或另起一句。

common_errors.wrong: which often makes them physically and mentally exhausting
common_errors.right: which often makes them physically and mentally exhausted
common_errors.explanation_zh: 描述人「感到」疲憊用 exhausted；exhausting 是「令人疲憊的」。

traps.literal_error: …, which often makes their body and heart tired.
traps.explanation_zh: 「身心俱疲」是身體和心理都非常疲累，用 physically and mentally exhausted 或 worn out；不要逐字寫 body and heart tired。

traps.literal_error: When take care of their elderly parents, many middle-aged people …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文時間子句省略了主詞，英文不能只留原形動詞；用 While caring for …（分詞），或寫完整子句 When they take care of …。

bonus.text: Caring for their elderly parents while juggling work and family, many middle-aged people often end up physically and mentally drained.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用分詞構句把「照顧父母」和「兼顧工作家庭」合在句首，end up drained（最後筋疲力盡）更生動。

1.restructuring_zh: 句首「照顧…時」省略主詞，英文用 While caring for …（分詞的主詞就是後面的 many middle-aged people）；句尾「這常讓他們…」不要用 this 另起子句，改成 , which … 指前面整件事。

references: However, many families are still not sure whether they are eligible for the long-term care services provided by the government.
However, many families are still unsure whether or not they qualify for the long-term care services offered by the government.
However, many families remain uncertain whether they have the right to use the long-term care services provided by the government.

patterns.label_zh: 間接問句：whether 名詞子句（是否）
patterns.frame: S + be not sure + whether + S + V …

patterns.label_zh: 過去分詞片語後位修飾名詞（由…提供的 N）

parts.zh: 然而，許多家庭仍不確定
accepted: However, many families are still not sure
However, many families are still unsure
However, many families remain uncertain
However, many families still do not know

common_errors.wrong: However, many families still not sure
common_errors.right: However, many families are still not sure
common_errors.explanation_zh: sure 是形容詞，前面要有 be 動詞 are。

common_errors.wrong: However, many family are still not sure
common_errors.right: However, many families are still not sure
common_errors.explanation_zh: many 後面接複數名詞 families。

accepted: whether they are eligible for
whether or not they qualify for
whether they have the right to use
if they are eligible for

common_errors.explanation_zh: 間接問句用直述句語序：whether + 主詞 + 動詞。

common_errors.wrong: whether they have qualification to use
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「有資格」用 be eligible for／qualify for；qualification 多指學歷或證照，照字面寫 have qualification 不自然。

accepted: provided by the government
offered by the government

common_errors.explanation_zh: 服務是「被」政府提供的，用過去分詞 provided。

common_errors.wrong: the government provided the long-term care services
common_errors.right: the long-term care services provided by the government
common_errors.explanation_zh: 照中文順序寫成 the government provided …，會多出一組主詞＋動詞；要改成名詞後面接 provided by the government。

accepted: the long-term care services
long-term care services

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「長期的」是複合形容詞 long-term；long time 是名詞片語，不能這樣修飾名詞。

traps.literal_error: … whether they have qualification to use the long-term care services …
traps.explanation_zh: 「有資格」英文多用形容詞 eligible 或動詞 qualify：be eligible for／qualify for，不要照字面寫成 have qualification。

traps.zh: 由政府提供的長期照護服務
traps.literal_error: … whether they are eligible for the by the government provided long-term care services.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文修飾語「由政府提供的」放在名詞前；英文帶 by 的分詞片語要放在名詞後面：the long-term care services provided by the government。

bonus.text: However, it remains unclear to many families whether they are entitled to the long-term care services offered by the government.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用虛主詞 it 把 whether 子句移到句尾，be entitled to（有權享有）比 be eligible for 更正式。

2.restructuring_zh: 「由政府提供的長期照護服務」英文要倒過來：先寫 the long-term care services，再用 provided by the government 後位修飾；「不確定自己是否…」改成 be not sure whether they …。

1.translation: While taking care of their aging parents, many middle-aged people also have to balance work and family, which often leaves them physically and mentally exhausted.
1.explanation_zh: 「照顧……時」用 While + V-ing 的分詞構句；「兼顧」譯 balance；「這常讓他們身心俱疲」中的「這」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 which often leaves them...；「身心俱疲」譯 physically and mentally exhausted。

2.translation: However, many families are still unsure whether they are eligible to use the long-term care services provided by the government.
2.explanation_zh: 「不確定是否」用 unsure whether 名詞子句；「有資格」譯 be eligible to；「由政府提供的」用過去分詞後位修飾 provided by the government。

issues_zh: 建議（不影響判定）：第 1 部分可補「While taking care of their aging parents」（aging 已在 elderly 的 alternatives）。
建議（不影響判定）：第 2 部分可補「whether they are eligible to use」（保留「使用」，與 eligible for 同樣正確）。

1.translation: While caring for their elderly parents, many middle-aged people also have to balance work and family, which often leaves them physically and mentally exhausted.
1.explanation_zh: 「照顧年邁父母時」用 while + V-ing 的分詞構句；「兼顧」用 balance；「這常讓他們身心俱疲」以 which 非限定關係子句指前面整件事，再用 leave + 受詞 + 形容詞。

2.translation: However, many families are still unsure whether they are eligible for the long-term care services provided by the government.
2.explanation_zh: 「不確定是否」用 unsure whether 帶名詞子句；「有資格」用 be eligible for；「由政府提供的」用過去分詞片語後置修飾 services。
